parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const r = { email: 'fermafabiz@gmail.com', model: ($json.model || 'veo-3.1-lite-low-priority'), prompt: 'One continuous take, filmed in a single unbroken shot. Begin exactly on the given frame and play the action below as written, in the direction written. ' + String((() => { try { const m = $('RG Motion Resubmit').first().json; if (m && m.sceneId === $json.id && m.motionPrompt && m.baseMotion === $json.motionPrompt) return m.motionPrompt; } catch (err) {} return $json.motionPrompt; })() || '').split(/\s*Negative:\s*/i)[0].trim() + ' Keep the world consistent for the whole take: every person, vehicle and object holds its shape, size, colour and identity from first frame to last, and each one stays whole and solid, resting on the ground and passing around other things rather than through them. Whatever the subject is holding stays in their hands until the end of the shot, and anything they pick up stays picked up. Everything the subject does not touch holds still exactly as the first frame shows it — doors, drawers, lids, windows and taped-up paper move only when a hand moves them, and indoors the air is still. Every moving vehicle has its driver. The background moves only as the camera moves, so parallax reads correctly. Audio: quiet natural room tone plus the sounds the action itself makes. Negative: speech, voices, dialogue, singing, narration, music, soundtrack, on-screen text, subtitles, captions, watermark, logos, extra people, duplicated subject, morphing, warping, reversed playback.', startImage: $json.imageId, aspectRatio: ($('Prep Video Regen').first().json.aspectRatio === '9:16' ? 'portrait' : 'landscape'), seed: $json.seed, count: 1, async: true, captchaRetry: 1 }; try { const a = $('RG Attach End Frame').first().json; if (a && a.endImage && a.sceneId === $json.id) r.endImage = a.endImage; } catch (err) {} try { const g = $('Regen Cooldown Guard').first().json; if (g && g.dropEndFrame && g.sceneId === $json.id) delete r.endImage; } catch (err) {} try { const m = $('RG Motion Resubmit').first().json; if (m && m.sceneId === $json.id) { if (m.seed) r.seed = m.seed; if (m.dropEndFrame) delete r.endImage; } } catch (err) {} return r; })() }}

parameters.query:
select sv.fields as scene, pv.fields as project, s.project_id
from hov.at_scene sv
join hov.scene s on s.id = sv.id
join hov.at_project pv on pv.id = s.project_id
where sv.id = $hov${{ String($json.body.scene_id || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 40) }}$hov$

select * from hov.at_write($hov$scene$hov$, $hov${{ String($json.sceneId || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 40) }}$hov$,
  $hov${{ JSON.stringify({ "Regenerează Video": false, "Status Producție Scenă": "Așteaptă Aprobare Video", "Observații Scenă": 'REJECTED — ' + String($json.reason || 'this scene cannot be re-shot') + '. Nothing was thrown away: the clip you have is still there.' }) }}$hov$::jsonb)
